m: Oven to 220°C. Cut the belly into 2cm cubes, toss with salt and spread on a lined tray.
Roast 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp and rendered. Drain off the fat.
Cook the rice. Quick pickle: thin cucumber slices with rice vinegar and a pinch of salt and sugar.
Glaze: soy, honey, grated garlic and ginger.
Toss the pork in a hot pan with the glaze for 2 to 3 minutes until sticky and glossy.
Steam the broccoli. Build bowls with rice, pork, broccoli and pickles, and finish with spring onion and sesame seeds.
l: Pork and rice together, pickles in a separate container.
g: Tamari instead of soy, glazed in a separate pan.
